summary.name: Garage
summary.one_liner: Garage is a lightweight, S3-compatible, geo-distributed object storage service aimed at small self-hosted deployments.
summary.what_it_does: The page is a bot-check interstitial from Anubis, so it contains almost no product details. The meta description says Garage is an S3-compatible object store for small self-hosted geo-distributed deployments. Directory listings that point to this page describe it as written in Rust, distributed under AGPL-3.0, and available as Docker. Beyond that, the page itself gives no documented features.
notable: S3-compatible API for small self-hosted deployments
caveats: Page content is an Anubis bot-check; no feature documentation was available on this page
